item.title: The U.S. Venezuela oil deal won't lower your gas prices. Here's what you need to know
item.description: The Trump administration announced a deal Friday to develop a vast amount of Venezuela's oil reserves, with the U.S. taking a majority stake. Energy experts say there are many reasons to be skeptical.

item.title: Attacks flare between U.S., Iran after month-long pause
item.description: U.S. threats erupt into attacks in the Strait of Hormuz; Iran retaliates against U.S. targets in the UAE and Jordan in the first exchange of fire since July 29

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: Trump says U.S. struck a deal to take control of 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil, U.S. and Iran resume exchanging strikes, funding at the top of the agenda as House reconvenes.

item.title: Russia's jet-powered drones bring empty Kyiv supermarket shelves and rattle Ukrainians
item.description: Russian forces relentlessly battered Kyiv and cities in the region around the Ukrainian capital for a fifth straight day, leaving some supermarket shelves bare after repeated strikes on warehouses.
